subject.title: Feishu auto-reply and `message` tool path bypass `message_sending` / `reply_payload_sending` / `message_sent` plugin hooks

question: Should this issue be split so Feishu outbound hook parity is fixed first while normal-channel `inbound_claim` broadening remains a separate plugin API/security decision?
rationale: The outbound hook bypass is a documented security/rewrite/cancel hook bug, but normal-channel `inbound_claim` would change plugin claim authority and routing order for all channel traffic.

options.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
options.body: Fix Feishu `message_sending`/`reply_payload_sending`/`message_sent` parity through the existing dispatcher/outbound hook work and keep `inbound_claim` broadening on a separate review track.

options.title: Fold into the broad hook umbrella
options.body: Move the remaining Feishu outbound evidence under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92374 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50126 and leave this item only as Feishu/inbound-claim context.

options.title: Solve all hook requests together
options.body: Use one larger design PR for Feishu outbound parity and normal-channel claiming, accepting higher compatibility and security-review cost.

recommendation.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
recommendation.body: Fix Feishu `message_sending`/`reply_payload_sending`/`message_sent` parity through the existing dispatcher/outbound hook work and keep `inbound_claim` broadening on a separate review track.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice turns on plugin-owned binding and `inbound_claim` semantics, where the history and discussion point to huntharo as the closest routing candidate.
